description: Use this skill for the replication lifecycle of CDC-based data synchronization: day-0 full load, incremental delta processing, replay ID management, gap event fallback, and ordering/deduplication using transactionKey and sequenceNumber. NOT for CDC entity selection, channel config, or edition limits — use integration/change-data-capture-integration. NOT for checking whether the two systems actually match — use data/data-reconciliation-patterns.
inputs: Target objects being replicated and their approximate record volume
External datastore type (data warehouse, database, data lake)
Acceptable replication lag (near-real-time vs batch tolerance)
Current subscriber state: new deployment vs reconnect vs post-outage recovery
Time the subscriber was offline (if recovering from an outage)
name: cdc-data-sync-patterns
official_sources: Change Data Capture Developer Guide (API 67.0, fetched from https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/get_document_content/change_data_capture/<page>.htm/en-us/262.0; pages cdc_other_events_gap, cdc_other_events_overflow, cdc_replication_steps, cdc_event_fields_header): gap event causes (1 MB, field type conversions, internal errors, database-level changes) and the four GAP_ types; GAP_OVERFLOW after 100,000 changes, one per entity, dummy record ID, field changes counted individually; transaction-based replication with a buffer keyed by transactionKey and the /data/ChangeEvents channel; sequence-number gaps when objects aren't enabled; mark-dirty gap handling with commitTimestamp and LastModifiedDate; overflow re-sync and delete reconciliation; header field meanings and merged recordIds.

Pub/Sub API Subscribe RPC reference (fetched from https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/references/methods/subscribe-rpc.html): 3-day retention; LATEST, EARLIEST, CUSTOM presets; EARLIEST after more than 3 days disconnected; replay IDs stored as bytes; keepalive FetchResponse carries the latest replay_id; ManagedSubscribe (Beta) commits the replay ID on the server.

Streaming API Developer Guide (`api_streaming.txt`): 72-hour retention for high-volume and change events, later purging, no guarantee beyond 72 hours (L324-334); replay IDs opaque and not contiguous (L352-357); -1, -2, and replay ID options with the -2 performance warning (L448-520); CDC retention 3 days (L613).
Metadata API Developer Guide (`api_meta.txt`): PlatformEventChannelMember, eventChannel, selectedEntity, enrichedFields, filterExpression (API 56.0+), file suffix and folder (L96019-96118).
Bulk API 2.0 Developer Guide — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_asynch.meta/api_asynch/asynch_api_intro.htm (used for day-0 and re-sync loads; see data/bulk-api-patterns)
outputs: Day-0 load strategy (Bulk API query job design)
Incremental CDC replication design with replay ID persistence plan
Ordering and deduplication design using transactionKey and sequenceNumber
Offline recovery decision tree (replay vs full re-sync)
